# lab-ca

One root for the lab: what the ingress serves from and every cluster's issuer signs from.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| secretName | string | `"lab-ca-ca-secret"` | Secret the root lands in, in every cluster.  `cli/src/host/pki.rs`'s `import_lab_ca` writes this name, so changing it here changes what a cluster's issuer reads and not what the CLI writes. It is an input so the address travels on the signature rather than being asserted against a literal in the floe that reads it.  |
| secretNamespace | string | `"cert-manager"` | Namespace that Secret lands in. Same contract as `secretName`. |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| zone | [DNS_ZONE](../signatures/DNS_ZONE.md) | The lab's DNS zone and the server authoritative for it. The only fully portable signature. |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| labCa | [LAB_CA](../signatures/LAB_CA.md) | The lab's own root: where its certificate and key are on the host, and where it lands in a cluster. |
| step | [LAB_STEPS](../signatures/LAB_STEPS.md) | Plan steps a floe contributes, keyed by step name. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `cloud` as the lab unit `ca`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.
